name: Bitcoin
investment_thesis: Digital Gold and primary sovereign digital store of value. Highest security and liquidity.
shariah_reasoning: Pure peer-to-peer medium of exchange and store of value. Zero Riba or Gharar mechanics.

name: Ethereum
investment_thesis: Foundational settlement layer for global decentralized finance, web3 apps, and institutional tokenization (ETFs).
shariah_reasoning: Native computational gas token. Staking rewards derive from transaction execution fees, not debt interest.

name: Solana
investment_thesis: High-throughput Layer-1 with massive consumer adoption, DEX volume leadership, and fast execution speeds.
shariah_reasoning: Native execution gas token. Genuine technical utility for transaction validation.

name: BNB

shariah_reasoning: Utility token for transaction gas fees and platform fee discounts. Free of credit interest.

name: Arbitrum

name: NEAR Protocol

name: Avalanche

name: Chainlink
